hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 5, 4. You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Turn — Jack. You bet again. Your opponent raised you.

wrongReasons: With only two pair, Q J wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
With only one pair, 10 K wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
With only one pair, 8 A wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 2 5

Your opponent flopped a full house and slow-played the flop, calling to disguise their strength. Once the pot was big enough they raised the turn and shoved the river — a classic trap with a monster hand.
